title: Space Defender
description: A classic 2D space shooter with power-ups, boss battles, and a global high-score system. Defend the galaxy from endless waves of alien invaders.

title: Puzzle Quest 3D
description: A mind-bending 3D puzzle platformer where you manipulate gravity to navigate complex mazes and overcome obstacles.

title: Retro Racer
description: An arcade-style racing game with a synthwave aesthetic, featuring customizable vehicles, multiple tracks, and local multiplayer.

title: Abyss Crawler
description: A roguelike dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels, turn-based combat, and deep inventory management.
